So far, TS38.321 only captures the Beam Failure Recovery Request (BFRR) procedure in Section 5.17. Since we now need to add the specification of the Beam Failure Detection (BFD) procedure, we suggest renaming the section to “Handling of Beam Failure” and to add two sub-sections for the BFD and BFRR (see TP in Annex). Proposal 1: The Beam Failure Detection (BFD) and Beam Failure Recovery Request (BFRR) procedures are captured as two sub-sections of Section 5.17 re-titled to “Handling of Beam Failure”.
